name: opentable-mcp
description: OpenTable reservation management for Claude — find slots, book, cancel, list reservations, manage favorites, search restaurants. Relays every request through the ContextMint Bridge browser extension (github.com/nullnet-app/contextmint-bridge) running in your signed-in opentable.com tab, so there's no cookie paste or bot-wall dance.

bridge.title: Browser transport
bridge.description: Optional. Which browser transport to use: "websocket" (default, the fetchproxy bridge) or "mcp-chrome". Leave blank for the default.

mcp_chrome_url.title: mcp-chrome URL
mcp_chrome_url.description: Optional. URL of the mcp-chrome bridge (default http://127.0.0.1:12306/mcp). Only used when OT_BRIDGE=mcp-chrome. Leave blank for the default.

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port
ws_port.description: Optional. Overrides the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149, the fleet-shared port). Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bridge bind interface, a literal IP only (anything else is ignored); default 127.0.0.1. Keep on loopback — it exists for a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank for the default.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term bridge identity keypair, an absolute path only (anything else is ignored); default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/. Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller. Leave blank for the default.

tools.name: opentable_list_reservations
tools.description: List the user's OpenTable reservations (upcoming / past / all).

tools.name: opentable_get_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile (name, email, loyalty points, metro).

tools.name: opentable_list_favorites
tools.description: List the user's saved restaurants (numeric restaurant_id, or null when absent).

tools.name: opentable_search_restaurants
tools.description: Search OpenTable by term, location, date/time, and party size.

tools.name: opentable_get_restaurant
tools.description: Get full details for a single OpenTable restaurant (cuisine, price band, address, hours, phone, payment options, rating) by numeric id, slug, path or URL.

tools.name: opentable_get_menu
tools.description: Get published restaurant menus, optionally selecting a menu title, with sections, dishes, prices, variations, currency, update timestamps and external menu links.

tools.name: opentable_find_slots
tools.description: List available reservation slots for a restaurant on a given date + party size.

tools.name: opentable_book_preview
tools.description: Preview an OpenTable booking before committing — surfaces the cancellation policy + saved card; required for CC-required slots.

tools.name: opentable_book
tools.description: Book an OpenTable reservation using a fresh slot from opentable_find_slots. Asks the user to confirm first (a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken) naming the restaurant, card hold and cancellation policy.

tools.name: opentable_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a reservation given its restaurant_id + confirmation_number + security_token. Asks the user to confirm first (a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken) naming the restaurant, date, time and party size.

tools.name: opentable_modify_preview
tools.description: Preview a modification to an existing OpenTable reservation; returns the new slot's policy + a modify_token.

tools.name: opentable_modify
tools.description: Modify an existing OpenTable reservation in place. Requires a modify_token from opentable_modify_preview. Asks the user to confirm first (a prompt, or a preview + confirmToken) naming the restaurant, the current and new slot, and the card re-hold.

tools.name: opentable_add_favorite
tools.description: Add a restaurant to the user's Saved Restaurants.

tools.name: opentable_remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove a restaurant from the user's Saved Restaurants.

tools.name: opentable_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the ContextMint Bridge connection end-to-end: round-trips a small public opentable.com URL and reports bridge role/port/timing plus a hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from an OpenTable-side problem.
